68713573.title: An Hye-jin
68713573.extract:
An Hye-jin (Korean: 안혜진; Hanja: 安惠眞; born 16 February 1998) is a South Korean professional volleyball player. She is a setter and a member of the South Korean National Team. On the club level, she plays for GS Caltex Seoul KIXX.
She was part of the South Korea women's national volleyball team at the 2020 Summer Olympics. The team finished at fourth place in 2020.

49498245.title: Kiiara
49498245.extract: Kiara Saulters (born May 24, 1995), known professionally as Kiiara, is an American singer-songwriter from Wilmington, Illinois. She is currently signed to Atlantic Records. Her 2015 single "Gold" peaked at number 13 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart. She is also known for contributing vocals to Linkin Park's 2017 single "Heavy".

81916265.title: Melanie Hasler
81916265.extract: Melanie Hasler (born 16 May 1998) is a Swiss bobsledder. She represented Switzerland at the 2022 and 2026 Winter Olympics.

68308052.title: Miki Ishii
68308052.extract:
For the wrestler, see Miki Ishii.

Miki Ishii (Japanese: 石井美樹, born 7 November 1989) is a Japanese beach volleyball player. She competed in the 2020 Summer Olympics.

61626245.title: Sandra Szabóová
61626245.extract: Sandra Szabóová (born 22 July 1996) is a Slovak female volleyball player. She is part of the Slovakia women's national volleyball team. She competed at the 2019 Women's European Volleyball Championship.
